canDoYue: 你識喺轉機前睇申報表、問幾早去入境處，同落地之後喺行李轉盤攞大袋。
canDoEn: Ask about a declaration and a layover, check a bag before immigration, and collect it at the carousel.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you check my declaration before the layover, and tell me which belt?
dialogue.glossYue: 轉機之前可唔可以睇吓我張申報表，話我知邊條帶？
dialogue.say: Could you check my declaration before the layover, and tell me which belt?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Your declaration is fine, and the baggage belt is number three on the left side.
dialogue.glossYue: 你張申報表冇問題，行李轉盤係左邊三號。
dialogue.say: Your declaration is fine, and the baggage belt is number three on the left side.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: If the flight leaves at two, how early should I reach immigration with one bag?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果航班兩點走，我應該幾早帶住一個袋去入境處？
dialogue.say: If the flight leaves at two, how early should I reach immigration with one bag?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Please reach immigration by one o'clock, because your layover at two needs extra time.
dialogue.glossYue: 請一點前去入境處，因為你兩點嘅轉機停留要多啲時間。
dialogue.say: Please reach immigration by one o'clock, because your layover at two needs extra time.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I take this small bag on board and check the big one?
dialogue.glossYue: 我可唔可以帶呢個細袋上機，大袋托運？
dialogue.say: Can I take this small bag on board and check the big one?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Sure. You'll collect it at the baggage carousel when you land.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。你落地之後喺行李轉盤攞。
dialogue.say: Sure. You'll collect it at the baggage carousel when you land.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: After I check the big one, is immigration through those doors?
dialogue.glossYue: 我托運完大袋之後，入境處係咪喺嗰啲門後面？
dialogue.say: After I check the big one, is immigration through those doors?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. Immigration is just through those doors, once the bag is checked.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。袋托運完，入境處就喺嗰啲門後面。
dialogue.say: Yes. Immigration is just through those doors, once the bag is checked.
